==Description==
'''Wimbleton''' emote is an emote that could be obtained at Level 24 of the regular [[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]]. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped, but it is not moveable or interactable. No music can be heard while performing this emote.

It had a cost of {{DuckyEggs|780}} or {{Robux|78}} ({{Robux|66}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total cost of {{DuckyEggs|8,990}} or {{Robux|1,720}} ({{Robux|1,450}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale).

==Trivia==
*Both the emote name and the description may be a reference to the online web series, ''Madness Combat''.
**The protagonist of the series is named [[w:c:madnesscombat:Hank J. Wimbleton|Hank J. Wimbleton]], the description of the emote may be referencing the namesake of the series, '''''Madness''' Combat''.
